title.en: China in Space: From Dongfanghong to Chang’e
title.zh: 中国航天：从东方红到嫦娥

clips.send: 2022. The Tiangong space station is complete. Three modules — Tianhe (2021), Wentian (July 2022) and Mengtian (October 2022) — joined in a T shape about 400 km (250 mi) up. In November 2022 two crews, six astronauts, met in orbit for the first time.

clips.send: 2003. Shenzhou-5: Yang Liwei, China’s first astronaut. Yang Liwei (杨利伟 Yáng Lìwěi) circled Earth 14 times in about 21 hours. China became the third country — after the USSR and the USA — to send a person into space on its own rocket.

clips.send: 2013. Chang’e-3 lands; the Yutu rover rolls off. Chang’e-3 made the first soft landing on the Moon by any country since 1976, in the Bay of Rainbows region on the near side. It released Yutu (玉兔 Yùtù, the “Jade Rabbit” who lives with Chang’e in the legend).

clips.send: 2025. Tianwen-2 heads for an asteroid. On 29 May 2025 a Long March 3B launched Tianwen-2 to collect samples from a small near-Earth asteroid, Kamoʻoalewa. That year China launched about 92 rockets — a record. Next goal: Chinese astronauts on the Moon before 2030.

clips.send: 2007. Chang’e-1 orbits the Moon. The lunar programme is named after Chang’e (嫦娥 Cháng’é), the Moon goddess of Chinese legend. Its plan has three steps: orbit (绕), land (落), return (回). Chang’e-1 did step one and mapped the whole Moon.

clips.send: 1999. Shenzhou-1: a test flight with no crew. China’s crewed spaceflight programme, started in 1992, flew its first spacecraft. Shenzhou (神舟 Shénzhōu) means “divine vessel”. Four uncrewed test flights came before anyone climbed aboard.

clips.send: 2020. Chang’e-5 brings the Moon home. The giant Long March 5 sent Chang’e-5 from Wenchang on Hainan Island. It landed in the Ocean of Storms, drilled and scooped 1,731 g (3.8 lb) of rock and soil, launched back into lunar orbit, and returned to Earth on 17 December — completing “orbit, land, return”.

clips.send: 2021. Tianwen-1 lands the Zhurong rover on Mars. Tianwen-1 (天问 Tiānwèn, “Questions to Heaven”, after an ancient poem) did three jobs on its first try: orbit Mars, land, and drive a rover. Zhurong (祝融 Zhùróng) is named after the god of fire. China became the second country to drive a rover on Mars, after the USA.

clips.send: 1970. Dongfanghong-1: China’s first satellite. A Long March 1 rocket lifted the 173 kg (380 lb) satellite from Jiuquan in the Gobi Desert. From orbit it played the song “The East Is Red” (东方红 Dōngfānghóng) back to Earth. China became the fifth country to launch its own satellite.

clips.send: 2012. Shenzhou-9: the first hand-flown docking. In 2011 China launched a small space lab, Tiangong-1 (天宫 Tiāngōng, “Heavenly Palace”), and the uncrewed Shenzhou-8 docked with it automatically. In June 2012 astronaut Liu Wang flew Shenzhou-9 in by hand. On board was Liu Yang, China’s first woman in space.

clips.send: 2008. Shenzhou-7: China’s first spacewalk. Zhai Zhigang (翟志刚 Zhái Zhìgāng) opened the hatch and stepped out into space, waving a Chinese flag. He wore a spacesuit made in China called Feitian (飞天 “flying to the heavens”).

clips.send: 2024. Chang’e-6: samples from the far side. Relaying through the new Queqiao-2 satellite, Chang’e-6 landed in Apollo crater on the far side, collected 1,935.3 g of samples, and came home on 25 June — the first far-side samples in history.

clips.send: 2019. Chang’e-4: first-ever landing on the far side. Nobody had ever landed on the far side, because you can’t radio Earth from there. First China parked the Queqiao relay satellite beyond the Moon (May 2018). Then Chang’e-4 landed in Von Kármán crater and sent out the Yutu-2 rover.

clips.send: 2012。神舟九号：首次手控交会对接。2011年，天宫一号目标飞行器发射，神舟八号与它完成首次自动交会对接。2012年6月，神舟九号航天员刘旺完成首次手控交会对接，刘洋成为我国首位进入太空的女航天员。

clips.send: 2024。嫦娥六号：人类首次月背采样返回。2024年6月2日，嫦娥六号在鹊桥二号中继星支持下着陆月球背面南极—艾特肯盆地，6月25日携带1935.3克月球背面样品返回，实现世界首次月球背面采样返回。

clips.send: 2020。嫦娥五号采样返回。2020年11月，长征五号在文昌航天发射场发射嫦娥五号。12月1日着陆月球正面风暴洋地区，钻取、表取月壤，携带1731克月球样品于12月17日返回地球。探月工程“绕、落、回”三步走圆满收官。

clips.send: 2003。神舟五号：杨利伟成为中国首位航天员。2003年10月15日，神舟五号载人飞船发射成功，杨利伟成为中国进入太空的第一人。中国成为世界上第三个独立掌握载人航天技术的国家。

clips.send: 2008。神舟七号：首次太空出舱。2008年9月，神舟七号航天员翟志刚身着我国研制的“飞天”舱外航天服，完成我国首次太空出舱活动。
clips.text: 2008。神舟七号：首次太空出舱。2008年9月，神舟七号航天员翟志刚身着我国研制的“飞天”舱外航天服，完成我国首次太空出舱活动。

clips.send: 1970。东方红一号：我国第一颗人造地球卫星。1970年4月24日，长征一号运载火箭在酒泉卫星发射中心把东方红一号送入太空。卫星重173千克，在太空播放《东方红》乐曲。中国成为世界上第五个独立研制并发射人造地球卫星的国家。

clips.send: 2021。天问一号着陆火星，“祝融号”巡视。2021年5月15日，天问一号着陆巡视器在火星乌托邦平原南部着陆，“祝融号”火星车开始巡视探测。我国首次火星探测一次实现“绕、着、巡”三个目标。

clips.send: 1999。神舟一号：首艘无人试验飞船。1992年，我国载人航天工程正式启动。1999年11月，神舟一号无人试验飞船发射成功并顺利返回。此后又进行了三次无人飞行试验。

clips.send: 2019。嫦娥四号：人类首次月球背面软着陆。2018年5月，“鹊桥”中继星发射，运行在地月 L2 点附近的晕轨道上。2019年1月3日，嫦娥四号在月球背面冯·卡门撞击坑软着陆，“玉兔二号”开始巡视，这是人类首次在月球背面软着陆。

clips.send: 2013。嫦娥三号落月，“玉兔号”巡视。2013年12月，嫦娥三号在月球正面虹湾地区软着陆，释放“玉兔号”月球车，实现了我国首次地外天体软着陆和巡视探测。

clips.send: 2022。天宫空间站全面建成。天和核心舱、问天实验舱和梦天实验舱在约400千米高的轨道上组成“T”字构型。2022年底，中国空间站全面建成。11月，神舟十四号、十五号两个乘组6名航天员首次“太空会师”。

clips.send: 2025。天问二号飞向小行星。2025年5月29日，长征三号乙火箭发射天问二号，前往近地小行星2016HO3采样。这一年中国完成约92次发射，创下纪录。下一个目标：2030年前实现中国人首次登陆月球。

clips.send: 2007。嫦娥一号绕月探测。我国探月工程以神话中的“嫦娥”命名，分“绕、落、回”三步走。2007年10月，嫦娥一号发射成功，绕月飞行并获得了全月球影像图。
